description: A required attribute is still required when defaults fill the optional ones
notes: The spec's conversion rules convert an object to an object type with attributes it lacks by populating them with null (spec.md#collection-and-structural-type-conversions), which gives b = null, while the README says a missing object attribute would typically result in an error when type constraints are validated or used. hashicorp/hcl's Defaults.Apply (ext/typeexpr/defaults.go) adds only a, and go-cty's convert.Convert, which the application calls next, requires every attribute of the target type that isn't optional (conversionObjectToObject in cty/convert/conversion_object.go).
